title: Mariner 4 photographs a barren Mars

tellings.quote: Mariner for space probe photographed the planet up close in 1965 these photos revealed an inactive Planet barren and apparently lifeless

plain: In 1965 the space probe Mariner 4 flew past Mars and photographed it up close, and the pictures showed a planet that looked inactive, barren and lifeless. Michels tells this himself, drawing on the Mariner 4 photographs, in an episode with a guest who argues Mars once had life, so the photos stand as the official picture that the episode goes on to question.
